name: euler-hpc
description: Run coding agents efficiently on ETH Zurich's Euler cluster: the session's node, allocation, storage rules and your own setup at session start; skills for Slurm jobs and software, and for moving data; `euler-jobs`, an overview of your sessions with their jobs and PRs for you and your agents; `euler-step`, which runs a command in an allocation you hold; and `euler-resume`, which reopens the sessions still open when your last job ended.

gpu_model.title: Default GPU model
gpu_model.description: Slurm GPU model for GPU jobs, e.g. rtx_4090; one your shareholder group can use. Blank: the agent asks.

gpu_fallback.title: Fallback GPU model
gpu_fallback.description: Model to try when the default queues too long. Blank: the agent asks.

group.title: Shareholder group
group.description: Your group's storage name, as in /cluster/project/<group>. Blank: not shown.

work_root.title: Work root
work_root.description: Where your repositories and work live. Blank: not shown.

notes.title: Notes for the agent
notes.description: Facts about your own Euler setup, on one line, separated by semicolons, e.g. where shared datasets live. Blank: none.

transfer.title: Data transfer
transfer.description: How your data reaches Euler, on one line, separated by semicolons: the machines it lives on and whether Euler can reach them, Globus collections with their IDs and path roots. Blank: none.
